_metadata.description: Evidence-backed Secrets Manager requirements mapped to the PRD operational targets.

requirements.title: Secret inventory discovery
requirements.description: When a repository scan runs, Secrets Manager shall discover declared secret requirements and normalize their metadata for resource-level inspection.

requirements.title: Security finding detection
requirements.description: When a security scan runs, Secrets Manager shall detect supported insecure patterns and report contextual findings.

requirements.title: Tier-aware deployment manifest
requirements.description: When a deployment consumer requests a tier manifest, Secrets Manager shall return the selected secret handling strategy and bundle metadata without returning secret values.

requirements.title: Guided operator journeys
requirements.description: When an operator opens the dashboard, Secrets Manager shall provide journey controls that direct configuration, vulnerability remediation, and deployment preparation.

requirements.title: Guided secret provisioning
requirements.description: When an authorized operator provisions a secret, Secrets Manager should validate the request and refresh the secret status.

requirements.title: Operator dashboard
requirements.description: When dashboard data is available, Secrets Manager should display resource, deployment, and compliance views from API-backed state.

requirements.title: Validation history persistence
requirements.description: When a validation or scan completes, Secrets Manager should persist the result needed to compare compliance over time.

requirements.title: Automation-friendly command normalization
requirements.description: When an automation client uses a documented command alias, Secrets Manager should normalize it to the matching API-proxy command without duplicating business logic.

requirements.title: Reproducible lifecycle and tests
requirements.description: When Secrets Manager is prepared for development or CI, its lifecycle configuration and phased test suite should provide reproducible setup and verification.

validation.notes: Test Genie owns the configured phased suite.

requirements.title: Suggested remediation
requirements.description: Where remediation automation is enabled, Secrets Manager may suggest or initiate a safe fix for supported misconfigurations.

validation.notes: No implementation exists; record a manual validation when this future capability is introduced.

requirements.title: Posture trend analysis
requirements.description: Where historical telemetry is available, Secrets Manager may show posture trends and unusual compliance deltas.

validation.notes: No implementation exists; record a manual validation when this future capability is introduced.

requirements.title: Policy enforcement integration
requirements.description: Where a deployment policy is configured, Secrets Manager may provide a decision hook that blocks a launch below the required security threshold.

validation.notes: No implementation exists; record a manual validation when this future capability is introduced.
